title: Additive differential fibre finrank formula
statement: For a finite type k-algebra S and a prime q with residue field K separable over k, if trdeg_k K = r is finite, then finrank_K(K tensor_S Omega[S/k]) = finrank_K(CotangentSpace(S_q)) + r.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 00TV, lines 38754--38779

proof.text: Use the conormal exact sequence for the localization and its separable-residue injectivity to express the fibre differential finrank as the cotangent-space finrank plus the residue-field transcendence degree.

Localize differentials and associate the tensor products to identify the middle term with K tensor_S Omega[S/k]. Add finite dimensions in the short exact conormal sequence; its cotangent term is finite since the local ring is Noetherian.

theorem fibre_finrank_eq_cotangent_finrank_add
    (k : Type u) (S : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    [Algebra.FiniteType k S] (q : Ideal S) [q.IsPrime]
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k q.ResidueField)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : Algebra.trdeg k q.ResidueField = (r : Cardinal.{v})) :
    Module.finrank q.ResidueField (q.ResidueField ⊗[S] KaehlerDifferential k S) =
      Module.finrank q.ResidueField
        (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace (Localization.AtPrime q)) + r
